_comment: Generated by ck-mcpeadables.py, and since 26 Oct by tooling/ck-mcp/spell_tomes.py on the live order (143 plugins), which merges: every spell tome in the load order (winning BOOK records that teach a school spell). The school is the spell's dominant effect (its half-cost perk's school, else its costliest effect). Rows already here keep their hand fields (rankWhy, dataRank). spellId is the taught SPEL. Read by serverspells.js; a new tome needs a regions-overrides tomes entry, or failOpen sells it everywhere.
